game.title.description: Name of the 2048 game card on the home screen.
game.title.notes: Do not translate the game name.

game.description.description: Short description of the 2048 game on the home screen.

game.playLabel.description: Accessibility label for the play button on the 2048 game card.

score.accessibilityLabel.description: Screen reader label for the current score.

score.best.description: Label above the best-score value on the in-game scoreboard, next to the current score.

score.bestAccessibilityLabel.description: Accessibility label for the best-score value on the in-game scoreboard.

actions.newGame.description: Button text to start a new game.

actions.newGameLabel.description: Accessibility label for the new game button.

actions.keepPlaying.description: Button text to continue playing after reaching 2048.

actions.keepPlayingLabel.description: Accessibility label for the keep playing button.

action.hint.description: Label on the hint button under the board. Shown in capitals.

action.hintLabel.description: Accessibility label for the hint button: it suggests which way to swipe for 2 seconds.

action.noHint.description: Short message shown for 2 seconds when no move is possible, so there is nothing to suggest.

hint.swipeUp.description: Hint label shown with an up arrow over the board: the player should swipe up.

hint.swipeDown.description: Hint label shown with a down arrow over the board: the player should swipe down.

hint.swipeLeft.description: Hint label shown with a left arrow over the board: the player should swipe left.

hint.swipeRight.description: Hint label shown with a right arrow over the board: the player should swipe right.

hint.orKey.description: Web only, after the hint label: the same move on the keyboard, key is an arrow symbol.
hint.orKey.notes: {{key}} is an arrow character such as a left arrow; keep it.

a11y.hint.description: Spoken when the hint appears; move is the hint label, e.g. Swipe left.

win.body.description: Message shown when the player wins, encouraging them to continue.

stats.highestTile.description: Label for the highest tile value reached, shown on the 2048 stats bento.

stats.timePlayed.description: Label for total time played, shown on the 2048 stats bento.

a11y.emptyCell.description: Screen-reader label for a board cell with no tile.

a11y.merged.description: Live announcement after a move merges tiles; lists the resulting tile values.
a11y.merged.notes: `{{values}}` is a comma-separated list of numbers, e.g. '4, 16'.

a11y.highestTile.description: Screen-reader label for the highest tile value on the board.

a11y.timePlayed.description: Screen-reader label for elapsed play time, e.g. 01:01.
